ignition_application.title: APPLICATION FOR CEREMONIAL IGNITION
ignition_application.//: Story Phase 16 (chapter 203): the Bureau of Ceremonial Ignition's 97-page application, played as its funniest questions, with the dull stretches as page-number montages. The chicken question is required: only one answer will be filed. Nothing in it is a real procedure.

questions.prompt: puffchester: (at the window) Page one. Name and FULL title, clerk.

reply: puffchester: (approving) Correct. In every particular.
puffchester: (rigid) The THIRD, clerk. There were two before me and they would both be very upset.
puffchester: I SAW that.

again: puffchester: Again. From the top. With the THIRD.

questions.prompt: puffchester: Page four. Reason for ignition.

reply: puffchester: Naturally.

options.text: He's been holding it unlit for three hundred years.
reply: puffchester: (misty) Three hundred and FOUR.
garrick: (from the lounge) That's a long-term strategic commitment, that is.
puffchester: (scandalised) There is NOTHING recreational about procedure.

lines: Pages five to thirty: ANCESTORS. All of them. With their opinions about cigars. Garrick reads three of them aloud for no reason.

questions.prompt: puffchester: Page thirty-one. NEAREST GRAND STENCHMASTER.

options.text: Brogath the Bashful. Next room. Mellow.
reply: brogath: (from the lounge, waving) Hello!
puffchester: (stiffly) Noted.
brogath: (from the lounge, cheerfully) Hello!
puffchester: (looking at you over his monocle) None?
vindicta: (from somewhere, faintly) I HEARD THAT.
puffchester: Write both, clerk. And a third, in case.

again: puffchester: Again, clerk. Honestly this time.

lines: Pages thirty-two to sixty: SASHES IN THE VICINITY. There are a great many sashes in the vicinity. You run out of ink. Bankworth lends you a pen shaped like a vault.

reply: From the lounge: BAWK.
puffchester: (very slowly) No... chickens.
brogath: (from the lounge, sitting bolt upright) SPARE?
Agnes the Second hides her head under his foot.

options.text: AGNES THE SECOND. OPERATIONALLY IMPORTANT. DO NOT TOAST.
reply: puffchester: (writing it down, in capitals) Do... not... toast. Underlined?
captain[determined]: TWICE.
brogath: (from the lounge, very quietly) Thank you, Captain.

again: puffchester: The form won't accept that, clerk. The form knows.

questions.prompt: puffchester: Page seventy-two. Fire safety officer.

reply: puffchester: Qualifications?
captain: I've been on fire. Twice. The second time I put it out.
pete: (from the lounge, without opening his eyes) I'm not anything. I'm sitting here.
garrick: (instantly in the doorway) Delighted to take ownership of the ignition workstream, Your Lordship. I'll circle back with a FIRE STRATEGY.
captain[tired]: (crossing it out) No.

lines: Pages seventy-three to ninety-six: the same question in twenty-four slightly different ways. ARE YOU SURE. You are not sure. You put SURE.

questions.prompt: puffchester: Page ninety-seven. Sign here. And here. And here. And initial the bit about the goat.

reply: puffchester: (a single tear) Beautiful.
bankworth: (stamping it with his crown) Witnessed! Solvent!

done: Ninety-seven pages. Initialled, witnessed, and stacked as high as the bell.
